answer_1.quote: This paper introduces a query enhanced approach of QKConv, which incorporates query generation to boost knowledge-intensive conversations and optimizes the dialogue system via unsupervised joint training.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the end-to-end performance of our models on the three knowledge-intensive dialogue datasets following the metrics used in prior studies. In particular, Entity-F1 measures overlapping entities between generated response and ground truth. KILT-F1 and KILT-Rouge-L (KILT-RL) only award points to instances with accurate knowledge selection.

answer_4.guideline: Crowd-sourcing workers evaluate each sample on three aspects: Coherence, Groundedness, and Engagingness, with a score range [0, 1, 2].
